briefing: Markets were neutral to slightly negative today (NASDAQ -0.6%, S&P 500 -0.4%), with no candidate showing the full four-signal confirmation (MACD crossover, RSI 55-70, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge) that past experience says is needed for high-conviction buys. Holding cash and existing 7 positions rather than forcing a purchase into open slots, letting automatic stop-loss/profit-target rules manage the current book.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-off day is when investors pull back from aggressive bets and markets drift sideways or slightly down without a clear catalyst. The disciplined move is to hold cash and existing positions rather than forcing new trades just because capital is available, waiting instead for stronger confirming signals.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險趨避」（Risk-Off）指投資人減少積極押注，市場在缺乏明確催化因素下橫盤或小幅下跌。此時較穩健的做法是持有現金與現有部位，而非僅因手上有資金就勉強進場，應等待更強的確認訊號出現。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%, a mild pullback rather than a decisive move in either direction. No single catalyst dominated the tape, consistent with a broad, low-conviction consolidation after recent gains. Without a clear risk-on signal, momentum candidates lacked the volume confirmation typically seen on stronger up days.
market_education.summary_zh: 主要指數今日普遍小幅走弱，納斯達克下跌0.6%，標普500指數下跌0.4%，屬溫和回調而非明確方向性走勢。市場缺乏單一主導因素，符合近期漲勢後的低動能整理格局。由於未見明確的風險偏好訊號，動能股候選名單也普遍缺乏成交量放大的確認訊號。
